datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2014, classifying geographic areas of Somalia by acute food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats with classification scales, scenario information, and collection dates to document the evolving food security situation.
